description: Undo a specific mutation by receipt ID. Inverts the recorded direction: an add/save is undone by removing, a removal by re-adding (playlist items or library). A playlist add undo removes only the rows it created, refusing when no row positions are recorded. The result reflects the refetched post-state. Non-reversible kinds return not reversible. Executing needs confirmation and is refused when the client cannot prompt (SPOTIFY_MCP_CONFIRM=never bypasses).

dry_run.description: Preview only, and the default: pass dry_run: false to execute the rollback.

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

name: undo_mutation
